title: slack-mention-worker final message
description: Schema the slack-mention-worker's last assistant message MUST match. The worker handles a single @-mention in a Slack thread, responds in-thread, polls for follow-up replies until idle / resolved / cap, then exits.

status.description: Terminal state. 'complete' = mention handled, replies posted, no pending follow-ups. 'exited-idle' = thread went quiet for 30 minutes. 'exited-resolved' = human posted a resolved keyword. 'exited-timeout' = 60-minute hard cap reached. 'blocked' = could not even respond (missing token, chat.postMessage rejected, etc.); summary MUST say what blocked you.

summary.description: One-sentence wrap-up of what the worker did during this run.

issues_faced.description: Problems THIS worker hit WHILE handling the mention — chat.postMessage returned not_in_channel, conversation.replies pagination edge cases, etc. Empty if smooth.

channel.description: Slack channel id the worker operated in.

thread_ts.description: Thread the worker posted into. Echoes the THREAD_TS from the initial prompt.

mention_ts.description: ts of the original @-mention message that spawned this worker.

bot_user_id.description: Slack user id of the bot whose @-mention was being handled. Echoes BOT_USER_ID.

slack_posts.description: Every chat.postMessage the worker made during the run. Useful for forensics + replay.
